targets.query:
from(bucket: "${INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "supply_temperature_c" or r._field == "return_temperature_c")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "power_draw_kw")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Messages stored per minute
panels.description: Flatlines to zero during an outage. The gap width is the visual form of M3.3 recovery time.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "sequence")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: count, createEmpty: true)

panels.title: Latest sequence number
panels.description: Monotonic while publishing. Compare against messages stored to identify loss.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${INFLUX_BUCKET}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "sequence")
  |> last()
